options.text: The ability to speak multiple languages fluently
The ability to interact effectively and respectfully with people from different cultures
The knowledge of every culture in the world
The practice of ignoring cultural differences to treat everyone the same

correct_answer.text: The ability to interact effectively and respectfully with people from different cultures

questions.question_text: How does cultural understanding help reduce conflict?

options.text: It teaches you to avoid people from different cultures
It helps you understand the reasons behind people’s behaviors based on their cultural norms
It ensures everyone agrees on the same rules
It eliminates all differences between people

correct_answer.text: It helps you understand the reasons behind people’s behaviors based on their cultural norms

options.text: A true fact about a group of people
A personal opinion based on extensive research
A fixed, often oversimplified idea about a group that is usually based on assumptions
A detailed and accurate description of a culture

correct_answer.text: A fixed, often oversimplified idea about a group that is usually based on assumptions

questions.question_text: Why is self-reflection important in developing cultural competency?

options.text: It helps you prove that you have no biases
It allows you to understand your own cultural background and biases to better connect with others
It focuses on changing other people’s perspectives
It teaches you to hide your cultural identity

correct_answer.text: It allows you to understand your own cultural background and biases to better connect with others

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of cultural awareness?

options.text: Assuming everyone celebrates the same holidays as you do
Recognizing that some cultures view direct eye contact as disrespectful while others see it as a sign of respect
Insisting that your way of greeting people is the best way
Refusing to try foods from other cultures because they seem strange

correct_answer.text: Recognizing that some cultures view direct eye contact as disrespectful while others see it as a sign of respect
